title: BC Asset Groups
content_data:
Business Center (BC) is a one-stop business hub for organizations of all sizes to activate marketing activities and reach desired audiences in a collaborative way on TikTok. An Asset Group is a collection of assets (for example, advertiser accounts) in a Business Center. BC Asset Groups API enables you to manage Asset Groups in a Business Center. For instance, Admin users of Agency Business Centers can use BC Asset Groups API to add advertiser accounts into a single Asset Group and assign Asset Group permissions to specific members in one go. To find out more details of Asset Groups, see [Asset Groups](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754705410074626). > **Note**
  • Currently, Asset Group API only supports advertiser account assets (`asset_type`= `ADVERTISER`).
  • Only Admin users (`user_role`=`ADMIN`) of the Business Center can create Asset Groups and add assets to them. Standard members (`user_role`=`STANDARD`) can only view the Asset Groups that they are a part of. This group consists of the following endpoints: - [Create an Asset Group](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1749001658583105) - [Update an Asset Group](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1749001662156801) - [Get all Asset Groups](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1749001665910786) - [Get the details of an Asset Group](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1749001669670913) - [Delete Asset Groups](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1749001673406466)
